title: Drummers who play too loud; Sid Catlett
summary: Garland complains modern drummers are too loud and try to play melody, and praises Catlett's soft playing.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: That's a nice credit to have. Ah, drummers, let's just say a few things about drummers, bass players and drummers are almost either natural enemies, either we're enemies or we're very good friends and it seems to me that they usually play too loud for bass players, how do you feel about drummers?
That's my argument, these drummers, they're too loud, and the dummies nowadays, want to play meoby on the drums.
Yeah, oh, man they got some bad dummies. You can't hear nobody but them. And they want to take you off, if you got a solo to make, they trying to make it.
They won't sit down there and play drum, they never play soft, you know, they don't use the fly brush, you know --

What dummies played soft, do you remember any quiet drummers who listened? Catlett
